question: Do index entrants acquire selective association with a frozen portfolio held by the ex-ante OMXSB-family fund clientele, relative to a frozen portfolio held by other broad Sweden benchmark funds and the SAME portfolios applied to three already-fixed matched stocks?
status: New exploratory design candidate. Baseline gate only. Root review required before ANY network-return outcomes. Prior0/118and1/118 failures unchanged.
fund_group: q0 nonempty unique-legal-ISIN simple unmixed OMXSB-family versus simple other broad-Sweden benchmark. Exclude invalid ordinary positions and ambiguous legal IDs. No condition on holding the target, eventual purchase, postbenchmark or survival. All eligible funds are potential clientele, not certified buyers or passively mandated funds.
weights: Aggregate q0 peer market value across all eligible funds in each group, normalized across allowed peer securities. This equals AUM-weighted fund portfolio weights before the normalization, if values share reporting currency. It is invested domestic equity capital, not expected buy size. No target ownership weight.
peer_rule: Exact ISIN/RIC using already-completed identity table; prior-to-q0 roster ordinary class and industry; exclude U/rights/redemptions. COMMON exclusion of all4 target/control issuers and the UNION of all4 prior industries. Same peer sets and weights before/after and for all4stocks. Exclude peers changed in focal review or with announcement-effective interval intersecting either fixed observation window. No substitute controls.
baseline_gates: Both groups need90% mapped capital in verified baseline ordinary cross-industry universe, effective issuer count>=10, >=3manager companies, TV>=0.15 and cosine<=0.98; all4 industry/class identities required. Report preexisting metadata overlap. Coverage goal83/118and12reviews retained solely as practical adequacy check; it is not power or a universal cutoff. No outcomes automatically unlocked even if passed.
diagnostics: Stock-weight total variation, industry/size-cell total variation, sector-and-size-balanced other-portfolio residual weight distance, fraction in reconstructed prior OMXSB membership, manager concentration, fund-AUM retention after strict whole-report exclusion. All purely baseline; no return correlation or test. These diagnose how close new metric is to a reconstructed index/style portfolio.
pre_nonholders: Not an alternative tested outcome. A baseline event-nonholder filter could be defined ex ante but changes portfolio as a function of target baseline ownership and requires certified zero positions. Using all4 nonholders can empty the cohort. We will not switch to this after observing outcomes.
window_candidate: 120calendar days AD-120:AD-1 and ED+1:ED+120, as oldwindow, with75validdailyobservations each. Longer windows overlap subsequent indexreviews and alter exposure, so no windowgrid.
interpretation: Selective clientele association, not causal risk effect. All-family benchmark-labelled portfolio is not Anton-Polk common ownership. Novelty over generic indexcomovement needs evidence of investor-specific variation beyond index/style composition.
precision_target: Chosen meaningful tolerance:95%CIhalfwidth<=0.05 in the difference-of-changes of two separate residual correlations, event-minusfixed3controls; interest in changes>=0.10. No actual power claimed from holdings. Need root-reviewed blinded preperiod calibration or exact reject before price test;14reviews and repeatedpeers can make precision inadequate.
